metas.name: Awarapan
metas.description: A loyal henchman is ordered by his boss to keep an eye on his mistress, and trouble begins when he refuses to kill her.

metas.name: Laal Kaptaan
metas.description: In an 18th century setting, a Naga sadhu in India sets out on a journey across Bundelkhand to seek revenge for an injustice committed in the past.

metas.name: The Accountant 2
metas.description: Christian Wolff applies his brilliant mind and illegal methods to reconstruct the unsolved puzzle of a Treasury chief's murder.

metas.name: The Aeronauts
metas.description: A balloon pilot and a scientist find themselves in a fight for survival while attempting to make discoveries in a gas balloon in the 1860s.

metas.name: The Tomorrow War
metas.description: A family man travels to the year 2051 to join a global war against a deadly alien species.

metas.name: My Old Ass
metas.description: A mushroom trip brings free-spirited Elliott face-to-face with her 39-year-old self. But when Elliott's "old ass" delivers warnings to her younger self, Elliott realizes she has to rethink everything about her family, life and love.

metas.name: Play Dirty
metas.description: A ruthless thief and his expert crew stumble onto the heist of a lifetime.

metas.name: The Bluff
metas.description: A Caribbean woman gets her secret past revealed when her island is invaded by vicious buccaneers.

metas.name: Dacoit: A Love Story
metas.description: Follows an angry convict seeking vengeance against his former girlfriend who betrayed him.

metas.name: Blade Runner
metas.description: A blade runner must pursue and terminate four replicants who stole a ship in space and have returned to Earth to find their creator.

metas.name: The Idea of You
metas.description: Solène, a 40-year-old single mom, begins an unexpected romance with 24-year-old Hayes Campbell, the lead singer of August Moon, the hottest boy band on the planet.

metas.name: The Wrecking Crew
metas.description: Estranged half-brothers Jonny and James reunite after their father's mysterious death. As they search for the truth, buried secrets reveal a conspiracy threatening to tear their family apart.

metas.name: Heads of State
metas.description: When the U.K. Prime Minister and U.S. President become the targets of a foreign adversary, they are forced to rely on each other to thwart a global conspiracy.

metas.name: Red One
metas.description: After Santa Claus is kidnapped, the North Pole's Head of Security must team up with a notorious hacker in a globe-trotting, action-packed mission to save Christmas.

metas.name: Nagabandham: The Secret Treasure
metas.description: A chosen warrior protects a mystical, serpent-bound Himalayan temple from those seeking to steal the power of the Brahma Kamalam, a divine relic.

metas.name: Crime 101
metas.description: An elusive thief, eyeing his final score, encounters a disillusioned insurance broker at her own crossroads. As their paths intertwine, a relentless detective trails them hoping to thwart the multi-million dollar heist they are pl...

metas.name: Road House
metas.description: Ex-UFC fighter Dalton takes a job as a bouncer at a Florida Keys roadhouse, only to discover that this paradise is not all it seems.

metas.name: Killer Heat
metas.description: Follows twin brothers who find themselves in a dangerous love triangle on an isolated Greek island. The investigation is given to "The Jealousy Man," a wounded detective.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania 4: Transformania
metas.description: After one experiment, Johnny turns into a monster and everyone else becomes human. Now it has to be seen whether they will be able to reverse this experiment.

metas.name: After the Hunt
metas.description: A college professor finds herself at a personal and professional crossroads when a star pupil levels an accusation against one of her colleagues and a dark secret from her own past threatens to come to light.

metas.name: Barreda
metas.description: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

metas.name: Balls Up
metas.description: Two marketers pitch a bold new condom World Cup sponsorship. After a booze-fueled scandal, they must outrun chaos to survive.

metas.name: Saltburn
metas.description: A student at Oxford University finds himself drawn into the world of a charming and aristocratic classmate, who invites him to his eccentric family's sprawling estate for a summer never to be forgotten.

metas.name: Couple Friendly
metas.description: Couple Friendly follows the journey of a Telugu boy and girl who both reside in Chennai. Their paths cross under unique circumstances, and the story deals with the challenges they face in their careers and relationship. Set in a city where they don't speak their mother tongue, the film explores the emotional highs and lows of navigating life and love in an unfamiliar environment.

metas.name: Governor
metas.description: Set against Indias 1990 economic crisis, Governor follows Raman, a reluctant bureaucrat unexpectedly appointed as the Governor of the RBI when the nation stands on the brink of bankruptcy. As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.

metas.name: The Assessment
metas.description: In the near future where parenthood is strictly controlled, a couple's seven-day assessment for the right to have a child unravels into a psychological nightmare.

metas.name: Tumbbad
metas.description: A mythological story about a goddess who created the entire universe. The plot revolves around the consequences when humans build a temple for her first-born.

metas.name: Over Your Dead Body
metas.description: A dysfunctional married couple retreats to a secluded cabin to repair their relationship, but each secretly plots to murder the other.

metas.name: McWalter
metas.description: A madcap secret agent is faced with a series of mysteries after saving the world from a dangerous criminal.

metas.name: Beautiful Boy
metas.description: A family coping with addiction over many years goes through the heartbreaking and inspiring experience of survival, relapse and recovery.

metas.name: Your Fault: London
metas.description: A forbidden love story between 18-year-old Noah and stepbrother Nick faces challenges as they pursue different paths - him in business, her at Oxford - while dealing with new relationships and secrets.

metas.name: The Map That Leads to You
metas.description: Heather's European adventure takes a turn when she meets Jack-sparking an unexpected emotional journey neither of them saw coming.

links.name: The Map That Leads to You

metas.name: My Fault: London
metas.description: An 18-year-old girl moves from America to London with her mother and wealthy stepfather. When she meets her stepbrother, an attraction sparks despite their efforts. Her estranged father also tracks her down after his release from ...

metas.name: A Million Miles Away
metas.description: A biopic about Jose Hernandez and his path from a farm worker to becoming an engineer and an astronaut. A tale of perseverance, community and sacrifice to accomplish a seemingly impossible dream.

metas.name: Tyler Perry's Duplicity
metas.description: High-powered attorney Marley faces her most personal case yet when she is tasked with uncovering the truth behind the shooting of her best friend Fela's husband.

metas.name: Culpa Mía
metas.description: Noah has to leave her town, boyfriend and friends behind and move into the mansion of her mother's new rich husband. There she meets Nick, her new stepbrother. They fall madly in love in secret.

metas.name: Fabian and the Deadly Wedding
metas.description: Hapless con artist Fabian crashes a quirky winter wedding, planning to steal a valuable gift meant for the bride. But when a murder disrupts his scheme, Fabian finds himself unexpectedly drawn into solving the mystery. A thrilling murder mystery comedy packed with dark secrets.

metas.name: The Voyeurs
metas.description: Pippa and Thomas move into their dream apartment, but notice that their windows look directly into the apartment opposite. This will set in motion a chain of events that will lead to disaster.

metas.name: Air
metas.description: The history of the game-changing partnership between a then undiscovered Michael Jordan and Nike's fledgling basketball division which revolutionized the world of sports and culture with the Air Jordan brand.

metas.name: Culpa Nuestra
metas.description: Nick and Noah's relationship peaks before facing events testing if they're meant to be together or should part ways. Can they overcome their past despite strong feelings, or are love and forgiveness not enough?

metas.name: Thirteen Lives
metas.description: A rescue mission is assembled in Thailand where a group of young boys and their soccer coach are trapped in a system of underground caves that are flooding.

metas.name: Suspiria
metas.description: A darkness swirls at the center of a world-renowned dance company, one that will engulf the artistic director, an ambitious young dancer, and a grieving psychotherapist. Some will succumb to the nightmare. Others will finally wake...

metas.name: Boulevard
metas.description: Two high school outcasts find unexpected connection despite their personal demons. As Halsey battles addiction and Luke confronts his own darkness, their growing feelings force them to question if love is worth the risk.

metas.name: Love Me, Love Me
metas.description: New at Milan's Saint Mary's, June is swept into secrets and lies: no one is who they seem, and love may hide behind the mask of the last boy she'd fall for.

metas.name: Subedaar
metas.description: The man who once fought for the nation must now fight enemies within to protect his home and family.

metas.name: Totally Killer
metas.description: When the infamous "Sweet Sixteen Killer" returns 35 years after his first murder spree to claim another victim, 17-year-old Jamie accidentally travels back in time to 1987, determined to stop the killer before he can start.

metas.name: Stree 2: Sarkate Ka Aatank
metas.description: After the events of Stree, the town of Chanderi is being haunted again. This time, women are mysteriously abducted by a terrifying headless entity. Once again, it's up to Vicky and his friends to save their town and loved ones.

metas.name: Red, White & Royal Blue
metas.description: When the feud between the son of the American President and Britain's prince threatens to drive a wedge in U.S./British relations, the two are forced into a staged truce that sparks something deeper.

metas.name: Trap House
metas.description: A DEA agent and his partner pursue thieves: their own rebellious teens, who began robbing the cartel using their parents' tactics and classified intel.

metas.name: The Sheep Detectives
metas.description: Every night a shepherd reads aloud a murder mystery, pretending his sheep can understand. When he is found dead, the sheep realize at once that it was a murder and think they know everything about how to go about solving it.

metas.name: Jurassic World
metas.description: A new theme park, built on the original site of Jurassic Park, creates a genetically modified hybrid dinosaur, the Indominus Rex, which escapes containment and goes on a killing spree.

metas.name: About Fate
metas.description: The romantic comedy is a tale of two people who believe in love, but seem to never be able to find its true meaning. In a wild twist of events, fate puts each in the other's path on a stormy New Year's Eve and comedy and chaos ensue.

metas.name: Coolie
metas.description: Delves into a man's relentless quest for vengeance since youth, driven by righting past wrongs, shaping his very existence. Viewers experience the complexities of his tumultuous vendetta journey.

metas.name: Upgraded
metas.description: Ana, an ambitious intern at an art auction house in New York City, misrepresents herself to a handsome wealthy man as the director. As their romance develops, her deception creates challenges that threaten her career and relations...

metas.name: Masters of the Universe
metas.description: Prince Adam discovers that the strange memories shaping his life are real when the lost Sword of Power resurfaces, forcing him to return to Eternia and challenge the tyrant who shattered his family and kingdom.

metas.name: The Runner
metas.description: A high-powered attorney must race through London to save her abducted son while following cryptic commands from a mysterious caller.

metas.name: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
metas.description: Follows Jack Ryan who reunites with CIA operatives to navigate a treacherous web of betrayal against an enemy who knows their every move, facing a past they thought was long put to rest.

links.name: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War

metas.name: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
metas.description: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

metas.name: Jerry West: The Logo
metas.description: He built dynasties, broke barriers, and became the silhouette that defines the game. But beneath Jerry West's legendary NBA legacy was a man haunted by perfection and pain. Through rare interviews with family and basketball icons, uncover the complex truth behind The Logo.

metas.name: Relationship Goals
metas.description: Explores the ups and downs of modern romance.

metas.name: Bhool Chuk Maaf
metas.description: Ranjan, a small-town romantic boy from Banaras, lands a government job to marry Titli but forgets his vow to Lord Shiva-only to be trapped until he fulfills his promise. A hilarious tale of love, fate, and redemption unfolds.

metas.name: Undercover. Inside the Bunker
metas.description: Bringing to light real images recorded during the greatest undercover operation in an animal experimentation laboratory in the world, Carlota Saorsa, now a protected witness, sacrifices everything and puts her life on the line to show the world the harsh reality she experienced for 18 months inside what she calls "The Bunker."

metas.name: Housefull 5
metas.description: In this murder mystery comedy, several imposters claiming to be the son of a recently deceased billionaire compete for his fortune aboard a luxury cruise ship.

metas.name: The Last Sunrise
metas.description: A young American woman with health challenges finds unexpected romance with a charismatic local during her summer in Majorca, forcing her to weigh her heart's desires against family obligations and her planned return home.

metas.name: Une Famille de Bâtards
metas.description: Paris, 1997. After his womanizing father is shot, Mohamed discovers two unknown siblings, Maurice and Morgane. Together they must save their father's seedy bar, Chez Momo, from debt and local gangsters with help from regulars.

metas.name: Pretty Lethal
metas.description: It follows a group of ballerinas as they try to escape from a remote inn after their bus breaks down on the way to a dance competition.

metas.name: Man on the Run
metas.description: An intimate portrait of Paul McCartney's trajectory after The Beatles, as he and his wife Linda form Wings.

metas.name: Vampires of Vijay Nagar
metas.description: A determined historian, sifts through old manuscripts, seeking clues about the mysterious legends of vampires in Vijay Nagar.

metas.name: I Am: Celine Dion
metas.description: A raw and honest behind-the-scenes look at the iconic superstar's struggle with Stiff Person Syndrome, a life-altering illness.

metas.name: Federer: Twelve Final Days
metas.description: Follows the last 12 days of the career of a tennis player considered the best ever as he plays his final tournament.

metas.name: Melania
metas.description: An intimate chronicle offers a rare glimpse into the life of Melania Trump, exploring her role as First Lady and her relationship with the former president.

metas.name: Animal Race
metas.description: Inspired by the illegal universe of the Brazilian animal lottery, a fearless young man must win a deadly race to save his sister in a dystopian future where each animal in the game is now represented by a runner vying for a prize.

metas.name: Awareness
metas.description: A teenager who lives with his father on the outskirts by running small scams using Ian's ability to generate visual illusions upon unsuspecting victims. Things get complicated when his powers get out of control in public.

metas.name: The Devil's Mouth
metas.description: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

metas.name: Zeta
metas.description: A Spanish spy must track down a former spy involved in an undercover mission decades ago, while a Colombian agent is also after him. Secrets from the past are uncovered.
